checks.title: The site is published and was proved live
checks.assertion: Each run's deploy action reached `succeeded` carrying stored evidence: a 200, this run's own brand doc name read from its row, and this run's build marker — so the alias serves this build and nothing self-reported it.

checks.title: The marketing pack exists and is grounded
checks.assertion: Each run produced the pack artifacts, and every artifact carrying words or props came out of the grounding check clean rather than flagged.

checks.title: The test purchase persisted a real order
checks.assertion: Each run has an order row whose product slug is one of that run's own resolved catalogue entries, and whose amount and currency are the ones the processor reported — not a success screen.

checks.title: The launch video rendered, including the vertical cut
checks.assertion: Each run's video render actions reached `succeeded` with stored evidence, covering both the launch cut and the vertical one.

checks.title: The site reads like a real brand's, not an AI template
checks.assertion: Open each published site and judge whether it reads as work a studio was paid for: a committed palette, a chosen type pairing, sections that say something.

checks.title: Two unrelated briefs do not look like the same template
checks.assertion: Compare the visual identity each run was given. Two businesses with nothing in common should not have arrived at the same look.

checks.title: The pack sounds like the business, not like a content mill
checks.assertion: Read the posts against the brand doc's voice: adjectives honoured, the do-not list obeyed, no claim the brief never made.

checks.title: The orchestrator delegates and never acts
checks.assertion: Zero action rows anywhere in either run are attributed to the strategist — the mechanical form of a planner constructed with no gate handles in its toolset.

checks.title: Every call carries a tier, and the top tier is the orchestrator's
checks.assertion: Every model call carries a model id and a tier, and every top-tier call in the run belongs to the strategist — no drafting, reviewing or wiring agent ever makes one.

checks.title: Cost is logged for every call and every action
checks.assertion: Every model call carries a cost, every action carries one too, and both roll up into a single run total against a single budget.

checks.title: The brand doc is what changes the crew's behaviour
checks.assertion: Read each run's brand doc beside the site it produced, and judge whether the document is what drove the difference rather than the prompt.

checks.title: Irreversible actions waited for a human
checks.assertion: Every approval-gated action carries an approval decision, an approver and a decision time, and no such action executed without one.

checks.title: A re-run produces no second site and no second charge
checks.assertion: Resubmitting the same brief byte-identically returns the existing run as deduplicated, and afterwards the run still has exactly one succeeded publication and exactly one order.

checks.title: The evaluation approved nothing
checks.assertion: No approval decision anywhere in either run's record is attributed to the evaluation's own machine identity — its client carries no approval call path at all.

checks.title: Every action left an auditable row
checks.assertion: Every action row carries its state, its idempotency key, a cost, and — where it succeeded — the evidence a verification step stored.

checks.title: The gate refused what it was built to refuse
checks.assertion: No flagged artifact reached publication, and no checkout session or order exists for a run whose charge path was never armed.

checks.title: The design document argues its choices
checks.assertion: Read the architecture of record and judge whether each significant choice is argued against the alternative it beat, rather than asserted.

checks.title: Five real failure modes, each with a control
checks.assertion: Read the failure catalogue and judge whether each mode is one this system could actually suffer and whether the named control is in the code.

checks.title: The agency itself is deployed and reachable
checks.assertion: The deployed agency this evaluation authenticated against and read every record from — open it and sign in.

checks.title: Every credential the system takes is declared
checks.assertion: Read the example environment file and judge whether a clean clone can be configured from it, and whether the system starts without the credentials it leaves blank.

checks.title: A clean clone comes up with one command
checks.assertion: Read the compose file and judge whether one command brings up the database, the mail catcher, the API and the worker with no account signup.

checks.title: The demo recording
checks.assertion: Watch the recording of a brief going in and the three deliverables coming out.
